title: A Garden for the Ember
author: Theo Winterbourne
blurb: Freya Reyes, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
